name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Sour Pebbles
description:
Sweet, tangy, and full of pop. The Cheech & Chong Sour Pebbles D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Sour Pebbles brings that cereal-aisle nostalgia with a sour twist: sweet mixed berry and fruity cereal notes up front, cut with a tangy, mouth-watering snap and a smooth, sugary finish. It's a fun, taste-forward profile made for anyone who likes their sessions bright, sweet, and a little sour.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Sour Pebbles flavor — sweet fruity cereal with a tangy, sour snap
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Sour Pebbles is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
